verdict.rationale: The docs say the single static-binary Superset CLI can manage workspaces, tasks, automations and the local host server "from your terminal or from CI". Agents can also be launched with a prompt programmatically from a script via the CLI, SDK or MCP server, so the core of headless scripted and CI use is documented. missing for 10: a concrete CI pipeline example or guide showing a headless agent run end to end, explicit confirmation that runs need no desktop app or GUI, details on exit codes or output handling for scripts, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
